name: warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-activatable-on-later-turn
notes: Warrior of the Fae Realm (eRcqucBKhX): "As long as you control CARDNAME, you may activate the banished card on a later turn." Player 1 plays the Warrior for real on turn 1 (3 reserve payments) and banishes a Striking Tides with the On Enter; the tag _warriorFaeRealm is present during that turn (step 5) and survives the turn change with the later-turn stamp (step 6). On player 1's next turn, clicking the banished card starts a real activation (step 9): exactly three reserve payments (steps 10-12), the attack-target prompt rejects the attacker's own champion (step 13, expected rejection) and the attack hits the opposing champion for 4 with the card ending in the graveyard (step 14). Replaces warrior-of-the-fae-realm-banished-sword-never-activatable-on-later-turn, which pinned the old behavior (tag stripped at end of turn, click was a no-op).

rulesClauses: As long as you control Warrior of the Fae Realm, you may activate the banished card on a later turn.

engineBug.summary: FIXED. The banished Sword attack could never be activated on a later turn. The banished Sword attack tag (_warriorFaeRealm) was stripped by the end-of-turn banish-zone cleanup in Custom/GameLogic.php ExpireEffects() (it retained only _seethingIntercession), and the ActionMap 'myBanish' branch checked only the tag + Warrior on field with no 'banished on an earlier turn' test. Fix: the cleanup retains _warriorFaeRealm and stamps _warriorFaeRealmLater the first time a turn ends after the banish; new WarriorFaeRealmCanActivateBanished() (tag AND later-stamp AND Warrior on the controller's field) gates both the ActionMap click and the green highlight, and the tags are stripped when the card moves to hand.
engineBug.affectedFunction: Custom/GameLogic.php ExpireEffects() banish-zone TurnEffects cleanup; ActionMap() case 'myBanish' (_warriorFaeRealm branch); GetCardHighlight-style tagged green highlight; new WarriorFaeRealmCanActivateBanished()
engineBug.verification: Per-step state dump shows banish TurnEffects ["_warriorFaeRealm"] at the banish, ["_warriorFaeRealm","_warriorFaeRealmLater"] after the turn ends, and the later-turn click starting a real 3-payment activation. Break/restore recorded in the fix commit message.
